interpretation: RMU is MUCH more aggressive than GA/NPO at the identical dose (13 steps, same lr) on TOFU -- forget_Q_A_Prob crashes to 0.41 (vs GA/NPO's ~0.80), model_utility drops more too (0.50 vs GA/NPO's ~0.59), extraction_strength drops much further (0.14 vs ~0.51-0.53). This is the OPPOSITE pattern from BioMistral-7B, where RMU was consistently the gentlest of the three methods at matched doses (data/gate2_results/RGU_rmu_pilot_summary.json). Combined with the earlier BioMistral-vs-Llama-3.1-8B RMU divergence finding (RGU_rmu_llama31_pilot_summary.json), this is now a THIRD data point confirming RMU's relative effect strength is highly model/architecture-dependent, not a fixed property of the method -- 'RMU is the gentlest method' cannot be stated as a general claim, only as a per-model observation.
